metadata.status: Engineering BOM baseline; not released for purchase or unit-cost quotation.
metadata.quantity_policy: Known quantities are integers; unresolved quantities are null and block cost roll-up. Functional assembly placeholders are not purchasable IC selections.
metadata.cost_policy: No prices invented. Separate recurring material, conversion, factory overhead, NRE/capital and commercial/service costs. Do not count an OEM subassembly and its included parts twice.

requirements: Resolve tube-versus-module purchase boundary

assemblies.name: Logix Aurelia 16 KB RAM expansion card
requirements: Add eight 16K×1 DRAMs, power/refresh strategy, identification ROM or defined equivalent, page/address decode, buffers, connector, PCB, decoupling and memory-test route. Specify who supplies refresh while the card is hidden by ROM/VRAM.

assemblies.name: Logix FlexiPrint40
requirements: Establish which motors, printhead, sensors and cable harnesses the purchased mechanism includes. Add motor/head drivers, power supply, local sequencer/MCU, RAM input buffer, font/firmware ROM, paper controls/path, ribbon/consumables, case, interface cable and print/registration test. A bus controller alone is not a complete printer controller.

assemblies.name: Logix FlexiDisk
requirements: Exact mechanism, number of drives, sides/tracks/density/format and usable capacity

floppy controller, data separator, sector buffer, local firmware/processor, interface electronics, PSU, enclosure, cable and alignment/read-write tests. The transport controller is not implicitly the disk controller.

assemblies.name: Logix Apple II Expansion Card
requirements: Apple bus decode/buffering and connector, identification/boot/driver ROM size, port-controller count, transceivers and any FIFO, Disk II sequencing/data handling, timing and firmware ownership. Freeze how native Disk II and FlexiBUS drive access coexist. Existing retail price is not component cost.

assemblies.name: Logix FlexiDisk II
requirements: Exact mechanism/media geometry

controller and firmware able to handle each specified encoding/format, sector/track buffering, local CPU/ROM/RAM, PSU/enclosure and separate format-interchange tests. Define formatting and read/write capability explicitly. Avoid silently using the standard FlexiDisk BOM if its controller cannot implement both formats.

assemblies.name: Artemis CP/M-80 backward-compatibility expansion module
requirements: Choose eight 64K×1 data DRAMs as a candidate, or another explicitly costed organization

add refresh, ROM or host-upload boot logic, mailbox RAM/window and arbitration (dual-port is not mandatory), bus transceivers/width conversion, doorbells, clock/reset, mapper emulation, connector and diagnostics. Count its RAM separately from system modules. PRO compatibility is not currently promised.

assemblies.name: Logix Aurelia network card
requirements: Host bus/mapper interface, controller or sequencer, serial framing/CRC logic, RAM/FIFO, firmware ROM, differential data and clock transceivers, port connector, protection/termination and cable. Specify Z80 CPU-service latency and buffers
bind the supplied OS media and any RAM prerequisite to the kit BOM.

assemblies.name: Logix Artemis network interface
requirements: Choose physical implementation. A practical first-costing baseline is one common removable NIC installed in new systems and sold for upgrades

this is a proposal. Specify 32-bit slot decode, buffer widths, PIO versus DMA, controller/firmware, link electronics, cable and assembly test. Do not cost both integrated circuitry and a separate card.

assemblies.name: 4-port Logix hub
requirements: Create three actual SKUs. Separate per-port connector/transceiver/protection cost from shared arbiter/clock/firmware/buffering/PSU. Define whether forwarding is streamed or frame-buffered, fault isolation, diagnostics and maximum cables. The shared one-transmitter medium does not provide 4/8/16 times 100 kbit/s aggregate payload bandwidth.
